messages:
alex_sales: Warm handoff for Aurelia Labs. Deal closed, $95k ARR, committed to Dedicated (2 GPUs) with possible expansion. They need Okta SSO, short enablement, and a document ingestion flow. Legal flagged data residency for EMEA - potential renewal risk. Adding @rita_csm and @mike_se.

rita_csm: Thanks — I'll own onboarding. Can you attach the signed PO and list of technical contacts?

alex_sales: PO uploaded (link: https://redwood.internal/deals/aurelia). Tech contacts: Jana K. (Head ML), Tom S. (Infra). Kickoff request: Wed 9am CET.

mike_se: I'll run the tech part. Quick notes: they want SFTP->object-store ingestion and prefer quantized models for latency. Need to confirm egress/IP policies for their security team.

tara_eng: I can prepare a small provisioning runbook and KMS notes. Any special compliance ask?

mike_se: They mentioned encrypted at-rest and audit logs to Splunk. Add to checklist.

rita_csm: Owners: Kickoff scheduling - @alex_sales; Tech kickoff & tests - @mike_se; Provisioning & KMS - @tara_eng; Support SLA & logging - @viv_support; Success plan + renewal tracking - @rita_csm.

viv_support: I'll open ticket CS-9021 to track staging provisioning, SSO test, and log forwarding. ETA 2 business days.

workflow_bot: Ticket CS-9021 created and assigned to viv_support.

alex_sales: Confirmed kickoff Wed 9am CET. Invite sent.

rita_csm: POC timebox: 30 days to show ingestion + latency target. I'll prepare a success plan and weekly check-ins. If legal insists on EMEA-only residency, escalate to enterprise.

mike_se: For kickoff I'll demo ingestion with a small sanitized sample. Ask Jana for a 500MB sample before Tuesday.

alex_sales: Jana agreed to provide sample by Monday.

tara_eng: I'll post the KMS/HSM integration doc link in this thread before kickoff.

rita_csm: Quick feedback plan: 3-question survey after enablement and a prompt set to monitor quality. Owner: rita_csm.

viv_support: Subtasks in CS-9021: create SSO test account, add IP allowlist, validate sample ingestion, configure Splunk forwarder. ETA 48-72 hours.

mike_se: Noted. Also Marco from their infra asked about RBAC for routes; we can support per-route API keys and console roles. I'll include a short demo.

rita_csm: Summary of next steps (owners): Alex confirm invite + PO (done), Mike run tech kickoff + tests, Tara prepare provisioning docs, Viv manage CS-9021, Rita build success plan and POC milestones. React with :white_check_mark: to accept.

alex_sales: ✅

mike_se: ✅

tara_eng: ✅ I'll share runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aurelia-kms

viv_support: ✅ CS-9021 updated.

rita_csm: Closing thread. Will reopen with kickoff notes and any escalation if residency is required.

workflow_bot: Thread archived in channel 'customer-success'.
